faqs.a:
A business license issued under this article designating a place of business may be
               transferred to a new location by the filing with the city clerk of a notice of location
               change. In case a business licensee shall sell his business, the then-existing business
               license shall become void and a new business license shall be issued by the city clerk
               for the location of the business upon the filing of an application for business license
               by the new owner.
(Code 1981, § 31-39; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002;
Ord. No. 4548, § 2, 5-2-2016
)
